idle.speaker: Mira
text: Evening. Or morning. Hard to tell; the Big Clock stopped.
I light the lanterns so people can find their way back. Not many come back, these days.

learn.speaker: Mira
text: Pip? You met a boy named Pip?
...I had a little brother. I'd forgotten his face. I'd forgotten I'd forgotten.
Take my lantern charm. If it's really him, he'll know this light.

waiting.speaker: Mira
waiting.text: Please hurry. The forest makes forgetting easy.

after.speaker: Mira
text: He came home. He's asleep upstairs, holding my old blanket.
You gave me back something I didn't know I'd lost. Lanternrest won't forget that.
